refs.excerpt: void EnterSubprogram(string id){var groupNode=doc.CurrentProcedure.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==id);if(!groupNode.Enabled||isLocked||activeRun is not null)return;var call=groupNode.Call;if(call is null){Safe(()=>doc.EnterOwnedGroup(id));}else if(doc.Document.Procedures.FirstOrDefault(p=>p.Id==call.ProcedureId)?.GroupOwner is not null){Safe(()=>doc.EnterOwnedGroup(id));}else SelectWorkflow(call.ProcedureId);}

void ReturnFromGroup(){if(doc.CurrentProcedure.GroupOwner is null||parameterEditorOpen||activeRun is not null)return;ResetEditingGesture();ClearToolGhost();if(toolPopup is not null)toolPopup.IsOpen=false;selected=null;selectedNodes.Clear();selectedWire=null;doc.LeaveGroup();}
 void GroupBreadcrumbBack(object sender,MouseButtonEventArgs e){if(doc.CurrentProcedure.GroupOwner is null||parameterEditorOpen||activeRun is not null)return;ReturnFromGroup();e.Handled=true;}
public void LeaveGroup(){var owner=CurrentProcedure.GroupOwner??throw new InvalidOperationException("当前不是 Group 内部画布。");SelectProcedure(owner.ProcedureId);}

public void SelectProcedure(string id) { if (!document.Procedures.Any(p => p.Id == id)) throw new KeyNotFoundException(id); if(CurrentProcedureId == id)return; CurrentProcedureId = id; Changed?.Invoke(); }

self.summary: 此自研循环先执行并收集本轮，再比较是否中断；它与当前REA在下一轮进入前比较的时间点不同。
self.implemented: ExecuteWithLoop从父NodeResults绑定解析start/end，再for(int i=start;i<end;i++)：写CurrentIteration、执行子工作流、Merge结果；失败则停止。成功轮解析输出/构建累积显示/AccumulateIteration后才EvaluateBreakCondition。源比较取本轮内部结果，目标比较取父nodeResults，二者转double后按运算符比较；缺绑定/无法转数值不触发中断。非累积输出保存最后对象；累积输出把Array逐项append再重建类型数组；Image勾累积直接抛异常。显示累积另按配置构建图形并Merge。
